title: Privacy
subtitle: In a few lines, no jargon.
localTitle: Your files never leave your device
localText: PidiElf has no server. Reading, merging, signing, OCR: everything is computed by your browser. No file and no text is sent anywhere.
storageTitle: The library is kept in your browser
storageText: Your documents, annotations and signatures are stored locally (IndexedDB). They are not synced between devices: use the ZIP backup to move them.
trackingText: PidiElf collects no usage statistics and loads nothing from third-party services. Fonts and OCR models are served by the app itself.
passwordsText: A password typed to protect or unlock a PDF is used for processing, then forgotten.
eraseTitle: You can erase everything at any time
eraseText: In settings, “Erase everything” empties the library, annotations, signatures and preferences.
